nl.title: Hoe gebruik ik Search Console en Analytics samen in een TripleZero-traject?
nl.excerpt: Hoe gebruik ik Search Console en Analytics samen in een TripleZero-traject: praktische handleiding in SEO/AEO, met stappen, controles en wanneer je TripleZero iT support inschakelt.
nl.bodyHtml:
Search Console toont zoekvraag en indexatie; Analytics toont gedrag en conversie. In een TripleZero iT-traject gebruik je ze samen.

Search Console

  • Queries, pagina’s, dekking, ervaring.
  • Technische uitsluitingen en sitemapstatus.

Analytics

  • Landingspagina’s en conversiepaden.
  • Lokale campagnes of organic segmenten.

Samen

  1. Vind winnende queries in GSC.
  2. Check of die landings converteren in Analytics.
  3. Optimaliseer content (AEO) of techniek (SEO) of lokaal (GEO).
  4. Deel exports in je traject-ticket.

Heb je na het volgen van deze stappen nog vragen? Neem contact op met TripleZero iT support via het ticketssysteem of plan een afspraak. Vermeld je domein, doelen (AEO, GEO en/of SEO) en eventuele AI-scanresultaten.

Gerelateerd: Toegang leveren; traffic drop.

en.title: How do I use Search Console and Analytics together in a TripleZero track?
en.excerpt: How do I use Search Console and Analytics together in a TripleZero track: steps in the AI-scan / agent dashboard for search, console, analytics.
en.bodyHtml:
This guide covers How do I use Search Console and Analytics together in a TripleZero track. You work in the AI-scan / agent dashboard, focusing on search, console, analytics — not unrelated side quests in other menus.

Preparation

  • Access to the AI-scan / agent dashboard
  • Focus of this article: search, console, analytics
  • Note of the current setting/status

Steps

  1. Start in the AI-scan / agent dashboard. Before clicking, note the current value for search, console, analytics.
  2. Open the AI scan or agent/workflow in the portal.
  3. Check input (URL, trigger, credentials) for search.
  4. Run the scan or dry-run; read scores/logs around console.
  5. Apply targeted fixes and retest.
  6. Document what you changed around search, console, analytics (old → new value) for support.

Verify

  • Result for search, console, analytics matches “How do I use Search Console and Analytics together in a TripleZero track”
  • No regression on a critical flow beside search console analytics
  • External test or second browser/network confirms the result

Tip: Work in small steps: get search, console, analytics right first, then optional extras.

Note: Do not blindly change production without a backup if search, console, analytics touches login, DNS, mail or payments.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).

Related: the AI-scan / agent dashboard, backups, tickets.
